finding.expected:
Resolve only the current branch configured upstream remote. If that
upstream cannot be resolved, fail closed. Add focused deterministic
coverage proving there is no fallback to origin or another remote.
finding.issue:
Transport remote resolution falls back to origin or another available
remote when the configured upstream remote cannot be resolved. This
violates the fail-closed configured-upstream transport contract.

original_constraints: The transport target is the current product repository's configured upstream remote; no product-specific repository name or executor-specific path may be hard-coded.
Verification must prove observable transport behavior and authority boundaries without source-spelling assertions.
